case_name: Joginder Baberwal & Ors vs The State & Anr
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent No.2 was solemnised on 29.11.2017. Due to matrimonial differences, both separated from each other. FIR registered under section 498A/406/354/34 IPC. Parties settled their disputes and entered into a compromise deed dated 27.07.2020.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise deed can be a valid settlement of disputes.
legal_principles.held: However, due to the intervention of the family members, the parties have settled their disputes and they have entered into a compromise deed dated 26.07.2020.
cited_cases: Joginder Baberwal & Ors vs The State & Anr, (2020)

legal_principles.principle: A divorce can be granted even if there is no claim of maintenance/alimony/istridhan.
legal_principles.held: Admittedly, the divorce has been granted.
cited_cases: Joginder Baberwal & Ors vs The State & Anr, (2020)

outcome.final_order: FIR No. 203/2019, u/s 498A/406/354/34 IPC registered at P.S. Maidan-Garhi, Delhi, and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: quashing FIR in domestic violence cases
